data.explanation: This is an invoice from a carpentry firm for a custom built-in shelf (Einbauregal) installed on 26 January 2026. The total is €1,487.50 including 19% VAT. Transfer the full amount to the IBAN on the invoice, using the invoice number as reference, by the deadline shown. Pay without deduction. If you think the invoice is wrong, contact the firm before paying. Keep the invoice as proof of payment.
